summary.text: Jordan Ulery is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 13 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2004 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a fraud investigator who has served on the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Ulery lives in Hudson, New Hampshire.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Saint Anselm College in 1971 and a certificate in paramedical science from the New Hampshire Technical Institute, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as an EMT, manager, chief investigator and investigator.
Ulery has been a member of the Hillsborough County Republican Committee and a delegate to the New Hampshire Republican convention.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2004, and he has represented Hillsborough 13 since the 2022 election.
He was assigned to the Ways and Means Committee in each session Ballotpedia lists from 2011 through 2024.
